meta._source: NOAA National Centers for Environmental Information, Storm Events Database
meta._definition: Years with a recorded Flood, Flash Flood or Coastal Flood event logged against the county (CZ_TYPE=C). Any such event counts; there is no damage threshold and no judgement about severity.
meta._coverage_note: The archive runs from 1950, but Storm Events only records flood events comprehensively from 1996; before that it is limited to tornado (1950+) and hail/wind (1955+). So this is flood history over roughly the last 30 years, not since 1950 — and the absence of an earlier event means the database did not record floods then, NOT that none occurred.
